item.title: What I See with Peter Fiorenza: Massage, lunch at colourful pub provides wonderful Melbourne welcome
item.description: As I write this, I’m sitting in my hotel room in Melbourne following a very relaxing day in this exciting city. I’m in town for the tennis, but I think I’ll save that for another column.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Police believe accused Mullewa gunman is still alive, no plans to stop searching
item.description: More than two weeks into the manhunt for accused Mullewa gunman Kenneth John Giles, WA Police still believe he is alive despite no confirmed sightings and have no plans to stop searching.

item.title: Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association round 12: Stateside deliver season-best figures, as Pumas down Hawks
item.description: Pumas continued their reign up top in round 12, but second-placed Stateside made a huge statement after posting several season-best efforts.

item.title: New safety measures up for debate with Beam e-scooter renewal on the table at Geraldton council meeting
item.description: The appropriateness of a suggestion for Greater Geraldton to join an e-scooter “ambassador” program involving volunteers reporting wrongdoing was questioned at a council agenda forum this week.

item.title: Greater Geraldton’s Buy Local gift card program becomes fastest program of its kind to reach $1m in sales
item.description: Greater Geraldton’s Buy Local gift card program has hit a magical milestone, surpassing $1 million in total sales since it was launched in 2021.

item.title: Domain’s December quarter data shows Greater Geraldton’s median has soared by 20.4 per cent to $590,000
item.description: While Perth’s median house price has joined the $1 million club, property values in Geraldton continue to soar to new heights, with fresh data showing a 20 per cent jump in the past year.

item.title: Mid West records rise in overall fires last year, but drop in the number of arson cases
item.description: The number of blazes Mid West firefighters were forced to deal with in 2025 was on the rise, with more than one in five deemed deliberately lit or suspicious.

item.title: Geraldton women’s captains confident their squads can continue their trend of country week success
item.description: Geraldton women’s country week captains Olivia Bidwell and Kylie Bremner are backing the experience, class and depth within their squads to take them to the top again this year.

item.title: ‘The perfect spot’: Geraldton to welcome 14 new Australian citizens on Australia Day
item.description: Geraldton will welcome 14 new Australian citizens on Monday in an Australia Day citizenship ceremony — an annual tradition that embraces our newest Aussies.

item.title: Geraldton mourns and remembers victims of the Bondi massacre on the National Day of Mourning
item.description: Flags flew at half mast on Thursday, as Geraldton commemorated the National Day of Mourning for Bondi.
